product.name: FlyFin AI Tax Filing Service
product.description: An AI-powered tax filing service that automates deduction discovery and prepares federal and state tax returns for freelancers, self-employed, and business owners.

product.name: FlyFin Quarterly Tax Calculator
product.description: An AI-driven tool that estimates quarterly tax payments for self-employed individuals based on income and deductions.

product.name: FlyFin AI Deduction Tracker
product.description: An AI tool that continuously scans expenses to find and track all possible tax deductions for users.
